title: Yellow Italian Rice Fried-Rice Balls
description: A creative twist on traditional arancini, these crispy fried rice balls are filled with a rich creme patissiere, then glazed with a sweet and sticky sauce.
instructions: Combine cooked rice, butter, and parmesan cheese in a large mixing bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour and egg.
Add the flour mixture to the rice mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Spoon a small amount of creme patissiere into the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling and shape into a ball, making sure the seams are sealed.
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add the rice balls, a few at a time, and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain the fried rice balls on paper towels and let cool for a few minutes.
Glaze the rice balls with the glaze (see below) and serve immediately.

glaze.description: A sweet and sticky glaze made with honey, lemon juice, and powdered sugar.
instructions: Combine honey, lemon juice, and powdered sugar in a small saucepan.
Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar has dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for about 5 minutes, or until the glaze has thickened slightly.
